mapper.select: SELECT cp.id, cp.display_id, cp.contest_id, cp.problem_id, cp.display_title, cp.color, COUNT(j.id) AS total, SUM(j.status = 0) AS ac, MAX(j.status = 0 AND j.user_id = #{userId}) AS is_accepted FROM contest_problem cp LEFT JOIN judge j ON j.contest_problem_id = cp.id AND j.contest_id = cp.contest_id AND j.problem_id = cp.problem_id AND #{endTime}>=j.created_time WHERE cp.contest_id = #{contestId} GROUP BY cp.id, cp.display_id, cp.contest_id, cp.problem_id, cp.display_title, cp.color ORDER BY cp.display_id asc;
